summary: "Firefox added a lot of focused checks around the media stack: audio callback timing, color and picture-region conversion, odd-sized video buffers, HDR metadata preservation, and WebRTC/GMP encoder edge cases. The new tests cover muted chunks, large intrinsic dimensions, crypto subsample validation, and plugin startup behavior, which are the places where media playback and video calls tend to break quietly. This matters because it helps catch regressions in video conferencing, DRM-backed playback, and advanced streaming features before they reach users."
